detail.title: Timesheet
detail.decidedWhere: Approving or rejecting this timesheet happens in the approval requests.

reconciliation.title: Compared with attendance
reconciliation.differenceHint: Logged hours less the hours attendance recorded

list.description: Every timesheet, newest week first. Open one to read its hours and how they compare with attendance; it is decided in the approval requests.

compliance.title: Not handed in
compliance.subtitle: Employed during the week with no timesheet submitted or approved for it
compliance.empty: Everyone has handed in this week.

report.description: Approved hours by cost center over a range of a year at most, each employee's hours split by their cost allocation. The download is the same report as a CSV file.
report.downloadError: The report could not be downloaded.
report.rangeTooLong: Choose a range of a year at most.
report.byEmployeeHint: Each employee's approved hours on each cost center
report.empty: No approved hours in this range.

centers.name: Name
centers.description: What staff time is charged to — a project, a grant, a department. Employees log hours against the active ones, and each employee's cost split points at them. One with hours or splits charged to it cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
centers.codeRule: Letters, digits, dashes and underscores, 32 at most.
centers.deleteWarning: Delete this cost center? One with hours or splits charged to it cannot be deleted.

allocation.title: Cost split
allocation.subtitle: Which cost centers this employee's cost is charged to, and from when
allocation.hint: The new split starts on the date chosen and the current one ends the day before. Each cost center once; together they make 100%.

mine.description: Your hours each week by cost center. Save as you go, then submit the week for approval; you can recall it while it waits.
mine.hoursHint: Hours by day, in steps of {step}, at most 24 a day
mine.noCenters: There are no active cost centers to log hours against yet.
mine.submitConfirm: Submit {hours} for approval? It cannot change while it waits, unless you recall it.
mine.recallConfirm: Take this timesheet back to draft? Its approval request is withdrawn.
mine.recalled: The timesheet is back in draft.
mine.rejected: This week was rejected. Change it and submit it again.
mine.waiting: This week is awaiting approval. Recall it to change it.
mine.leaveConfirm: This week has hours that are not saved. Leave it and lose them?

problems.increment: Hours are entered in steps of {step}.
problems.dayOver24: A day cannot have more than 24 hours.
problems.noCenter: Choose a cost center for every line with hours.
